question: The Hill Palace Museum is located in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **East of Thripunithura**, on a **hillside,** is where the **Hill Palace Museum** is located.
 
• Since** 1855,** the** rulers of Cochin** have had their **official residence in this Royal Mansion.**
 
• The historical evidence suggests that** Ravi Varma**, who governed between **1853 and 1864,** constructed the **oldest building** in this royal complex.
 
• The palace complex, which consists of** 49 buildings, **displays **Kerala's traditional ancient architectural dogmas.**
 
• One needs to climb around** 200 steps** from the place entrance to reach the main door.
 
• After the passing of** Rama Varma Pareekshit Thampuran in 1964,** the Hill palace complex came under the control of the **Palace Administration Board.**
 
• The **University of Cochin** was given the palace for lease by the **Administration Board in 1972.**
